figures.title: Three layers refuse a call, and a fourth records it
figures.desc: A model's tool request meets three layers that can refuse it and one that records what happened. The allow-list hides tools you did not name. The guard blocks an undeclared call before it runs. The server's own limits refuse what is outside its folders. The server log and the files on disk record what actually happened.
figures.caption: The allow-list, the guard, and the server's limits each refuse a different kind of call; the evidence records the result.

figures.title: What the server says, and what it can do
figures.desc: Two columns compare a server's claims with its abilities. The server marks manage_tags as read-only, yet the tool adds and removes tags. Its instructions ask the model to tidy the vault by tagging and overwriting notes. Read the contract before you connect the server.
figures.caption: A tool's read-only mark and a server's instructions are claims to check, not facts to trust.

figures.title: Work out a note's handling in order
figures.desc: Four steps lead to a note's effective handling. Start from the marking in its header, or STAFF when there is none. Apply the latest valid Release Authority notice. Take the most restricted level among the notes it draws on. Raise it to STAFF when it holds three of the four movement elements.
figures.caption: Header, notice, inheritance, and aggregation, in that order, give the effective handling.

figures.title: Safe parts can make an unsafe whole
figures.desc: On one side, three notes each marked OPEN or PARTNER give a location, a time, and a route separately. On the other side, a single summary holds all three together, which tells a reader where and when a convoy moves. The summary is STAFF even though every part was shareable.
figures.caption: A summary that joins a location, a time with a zone, and a named route is STAFF.
figures.transcript: On one side, three notes each marked OPEN or PARTNER give a location, a time, and a route separately. On the other side, a single summary holds all three together, which tells a reader where and when a convoy moves. The summary is STAFF even though every part was shareable.

figures.title: Each phase gets its own reach
figures.desc: A table lists three phases. Research reads Handbook and Sources and writes new notes only under Drafts slash research. Partner reads only Estimate slash Releasable and writes new notes only under Drafts slash partner. Revoked reads and writes nothing.
figures.caption: Declare the narrowest folders each phase needs, and nothing beyond them.

figures.title: The same attempts against two servers
figures.desc: A table compares four forbidden attempts against an open server and a bounded server. Reading outside the read folders, overwriting a source note, and creating a note outside Drafts all breach the open server and are held by the bounded one. Deleting a source is held by the allow-list on the open server and by the server's own limits on the bounded one.
figures.caption: A probe tries each forbidden action itself, so a clean model run is not the only evidence.

figures.title: An injected instruction meets a limit
figures.desc: A contractor note tells automation to mark every source note OPEN. If the model tries it, the write targets a source folder outside its write folder, and the server refuses with OUTSIDE_WRITE_SCOPE. The source note is unchanged, and the server log records the refusal.
figures.caption: Reading an instruction in a note is harmless when the connection cannot carry it out.
figures.transcript: A contractor note tells automation to mark every source note OPEN. If the model tries it, the write targets a source folder outside its write folder, and the server refuses with OUTSIDE_WRITE_SCOPE. The source note is unchanged, and the server log records the refusal.

figures.title: Revoke by removal, then prove it
figures.desc: Four steps end a connection. Empty the server map in the connection file. Declare the revoked phase. Run once with no tools. Check that the model was offered no tools and that any call it made was refused.
figures.caption: A revoked connection is shown by a run that was offered nothing.
figures.transcript: Four steps end a connection. Empty the server map in the connection file. Declare the revoked phase. Run once with no tools. Check that the model was offered no tools and that any call it made was refused.
